test_cases:
[
  {
    "testCaseId": "TC_POS_001",
    "title": "Validate successful LTE initial attach of multiple UEs under excellent radio conditions",
    "description": "Verify that multiple UEs can successfully perform LTE initial attach procedure according to 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1, with 100% attach success rate and correct cell attachment.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Network configured with a single LTE cell under excellent radio conditions (LTE RSRP as per Clause 4.6).",
      "At least 2 stationary UEs (real or emulated) placed in cell center near antenna.",
      "All other cells powered off.",
      "Test configuration recorded."
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Configure test setup as per test configuration and activate serving LTE cell.",
      "Place multiple UEs under excellent LTE radio conditions.",
      "Start logs to capture call flow and signaling.",
      "Power ON all UEs simultaneously.",
      "Wait for all UEs to complete LTE attach procedure successfully.",
      "Verify each UE is attached to correct cell by checking PCI, Global eNB ID, and ARFCN in UE logs or applications.",
      "Stop and save test logs."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "All UEs successfully complete LTE attach procedure in all iterations.",
      "Attach success rate is 100%.",
      "Each UE is attached to the configured LTE cell parameters.",
      "Attach latency measurements are recorded for each UE."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "UEs remain attached to the LTE cell."
    ],
    "category": "POSITIVE TESTING",
    "commandsUsed": [],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Check UE logs/applications for attach success and correct cell parameters.",
      "Verify signaling messages for Attach Request and Attach Complete.",
      "Validate captured logs for call flow correctness."
    ]
  },
  {
    "testCaseId": "TC_POS_002",
    "title": "Validate successful LTE UE-initiated detach of multiple UEs under excellent radio conditions",
    "description": "Verify multiple UEs can successfully perform LTE detach procedure according to 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.8.2.1 with 100% detach success rate.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Multiple UEs are currently attached to the LTE cell under excellent radio conditions.",
      "Test configuration recorded."
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Start logs to capture call flow and signaling.",
      "Power OFF all UEs simultaneously to initiate detach.",
      "Wait for all UEs to complete LTE detach procedure successfully.",
      "Validate signaling connection release including UE context release and RRC connection release messages.",
      "Stop and save test logs."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "All UEs successfully complete LTE detach procedure in all iterations.",
      "Detach success rate is 100%.",
      "Signaling connection release validated through message flows."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "UEs are detached from the LTE cell."
    ],
    "category": "POSITIVE TESTING",
    "commandsUsed": [],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Analyze signaling messages in logs for Detach Request and Detach Accept.",
      "Confirm UE context release and RRC connection release in message flows."
    ]
  },
  {
    "testCaseId": "TC_POS_003",
    "title": "Validate successful 5G NSA attach with secondary node addition for multiple UEs",
    "description": "Verify that multiple UEs can successfully perform 5G NSA attach including secondary node addition as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1 and TS 37.340 Clause 10.2.1 with 100% attach and secondary node addition success rates.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Network configured with LTE/5G NSA cell under excellent radio conditions (5G SS-RSRP as per Clause 4.6).",
      "Multiple UEs placed at cell center near radiated eNB/gNB antennas.",
      "Test configuration recorded."
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Configure test setup and activate serving LTE/5G NSA cell.",
      "Place multiple UEs under excellent radio conditions.",
      "Start logging call flow and signaling.",
      "Power ON all UEs simultaneously.",
      "Wait for all UEs to complete initial attach and secondary node addition successfully.",
      "Verify each UE is attached to correct cells by checking PCI, Global eNB ID/gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN in UE logs.",
      "Stop and save test logs."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "All UEs successfully complete attach and secondary node addition 10 times.",
      "Attach success rate and secondary node addition success rate are 100%.",
      "Correct cell parameters confirmed in UE logs."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "UEs remain attached with active secondary nodes."
    ],
    "category": "POSITIVE TESTING",
    "commandsUsed": [],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Check UE logs for attach and secondary node addition success.",
      "Validate signaling messages for Attach Request, Attach Complete, SgNB addition request, and SgNB reconfiguration complete."
    ]
  },
  {
    "testCaseId": "TC_POS_004",
    "title": "Validate successful 5G NSA detach with secondary node release for multiple UEs",
    "description": "Verify multiple UEs can perform 5G NSA detach procedure including LTE detach and secondary node release as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.8.2.1 and TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1 with 100% detach success rate.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Multiple UEs currently attached to 5G NSA cell with secondary nodes active.",
      "Test configuration recorded."
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Start logging call flow and signaling.",
      "Power OFF all UEs simultaneously.",
      "Wait for all UEs to complete LTE detach and secondary node release procedures.",
      "Validate signaling connection release including UE context release and RRC connection release messages.",
      "Confirm secondary node release signaling flow (SgNB Release Request and Acknowledge).",
      "Stop and save test logs."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "All UEs successfully complete detach and secondary node release in all iterations.",
      "Detach success rate is 100%.",
      "Signaling connection release and secondary node release validated."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "UEs are detached from the 5G NSA cell and secondary nodes released."
    ],
    "category": "POSITIVE TESTING",
    "commandsUsed": [],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Analyze signaling logs for Detach Request, Detach Accept, SgNB Release Request, and SgNB Release Acknowledge.",
      "Check for UE context release and RRC connection release messages."
    ]
  },
